  "component_id": "BAY-04",

  "contradictory_evidence_ids": [],
  "decision_summary": [
    "Verified solid amber LED on SRV-004 BAY-04 via pixel analysis and vision model, matching technician report of solid amber.",
    "Corroborated predictive failure via two telemetry snapshots showing progression to failing SMART with reallocated sectors 164, pending 45, predictive failure flagged.",
    "Corroborated via system logs showing SMART warning threshold breach, unrecovered Medium Error read failure, and controller asserting predictive failure with amber indicator.",
    "Excluded benign RAID rebuild as cause: rebuild activity is on BAY-02 with blinking amber per manual, not BAY-04 solid amber.",
    "Applied vendor rule that solid amber denotes reallocation limit breach or uncorrected errors requiring replacement."
  ],
  "device_id": "SRV-004",
  "incident_id": "INC-SRV-004-BAY-04",
  "missing_information": "None. Extended surface scan described in MAN-DIAG-01 not required as discriminating test because reallocated sectors with predictive failure already confirm media failure per MAN-LED-01; pending-only rule does not apply.",
  "reasoning": "Solid amber on BAY-04 confirmed visually. Latest telemetry EV-TEL-SRV004-BAY04-S2 shows SMART failing, predictive_failure true, reallocated 164, pending 45, read_error_rate 1820, RAID degraded, progressed from EV-TEL-SRV004-BAY04-S1. Logs show EVT-SMART-WARN threshold breach, EVT-SCSI-TIMEOUT Medium Error ASC 0x11 unrecovered read error, and EVT-DRV-PREDICT-FAIL asserting SMART predictive failure and enabling amber fault indicator. Manual MAN-LED-01 defines solid amber as predictive failure or unrecoverable threshold breach requiring replacement, distinct from blinking amber rebuild defined in MAN-LED-01 and MAN-RAID-01. Rebuild log is for BAY-02 only, excluding benign cause for BAY-04. Temperature 49C below 55C threshold per MAN-ERR-03. Two independent source types plus manual corroborate physical failure with both reallocated and pending sectors, not pending-alone.",
  "recommended_action": "Replace drive in SRV-004 BAY-04 per MAN-REPLACE-01 hot-swap procedure after verifying array redundancy and offline status; use identical or greater capacity; do not remove BAY-02 during active rebuild.",
  "status": "confirmed",
  "summary": "Drive SRV-004 BAY-04 is failing with solid amber predictive failure asserted; reallocated sectors, unrecovered read errors and controller fault corroborate hardware failure requiring replacement.",
